note: The names each EAS environment must hold for this app: names only, never a value. scripts/release/state.mjs checks them with eas env:list (project and account scope); scripts/__tests__/release-state.test.ts holds this list to the names src/lib/env.ts reads. preview is the testflight profile's environment (eas.json), so the TestFlight builds, their updates and the PR check's fingerprint read it; production is the store build's. docs/release/README.md, 'EAS environment'.
